column1: # Hand-checked en -> zh-Hant (Taiwan) terms: common UI words (Windows / Android / web style), error dialogs,
# signs / notices, transit, nutrition and allergen labels, menus.  Written for this project (GPL-3, also offered as CC0).
#   mode: x = whole block only; s = also inside a sentence / line (whole words, any case); q = inside a line only when
#         the rest of the line is an amount (Sodium 87.2 mg, Iron 2 mg 10%); blank = by rule (one word x, a negation x).
#   note: eval = added after looking at an eval_web failure (so its eval gain is not held out).
# Matching is case-insensitive (SAVE, Save, save).  Words whose sense depends on context are NOT here (Open, Closed,
# Exit, Transfer, Local, Information, Security, Storage, History, Review, Table, Line, Gate, Free, Stop, Platform alone):
